additional_info.subject: RE: 0367662 - ID0367662-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R2 170001523] Cable cooling error CRM:00658000641
additional_info.body:
Hello Marnic,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0367662 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
BE
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Please find the below steps for troubleshooting.
1. Check for the 6 to 11 pin on the microcontroller that is been inside the charging gun.
2. Check for any loose between KF10 & KF11 pins that are connected to the XD101 connector.
I have highlighted the wirings that is to be checked below for your reference.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
BE
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
